description: LINEMOD-Occlusion (LM-O) BOP test set - 1 test scene with heavy occlusion, 8 objects

preprocessing.description: Square resize with padding to maintain aspect ratio. Depth scale 1000.0 converts mm to m.

camera.description: FIXED camera intrinsics per scene. Loaded from scene_camera.json.

mesh_scale_description: BOP meshes are in millimeters, convert to meters for pose evaluation

symmetries.description: eggbox (10) and glue (11) have discrete symmetries

objects.description: 8 objects from LINEMOD with heavy occlusion in single test scene

format.description: BOP19 format with visible masks and GT poses in JSON

test_set.description: BOP curated test set with 200 target frames (single occlusion scene)

notes: LM-O is LINEMOD with added occlusion - same format as LM
Single test scene (scene 2) with multiple objects and heavy occlusion
scene_gt_info.json contains visib_fract for occlusion analysis
Depth maps are in PNG format with 1.0mm units (uint16)
GT poses in scene_gt.json: cam_R_m2c (flattened 3x3), cam_t_m2c (mm units)
Object naming: simple obj_id format (obj_1, obj_5) for partonomy compatibility
